copy.curiosityHook: Left without her father's guidance, can Giulia survive the unrelenting pressure of the GT track all on her own?
copy.description: At seventeen, Giulia De Martino competes in the GT Championship guided by her father Mario. When sudden upheaval changes everything, she is forced to navigate the high-stakes circuit and her personal life entirely alone.
copy.vibeSummary: Fast-paced, emotionally intense racing drama demanding engaged attention for a solo, high-stakes ride.
copy.whyWatch: Matteo Rovere drives this high-velocity Italian drama, fusing the adrenalized rush of competitive motorsport with an emotionally weighty story of solitary resilience.

allowedMaterial: Giulia De Martino as a 17-year-old pilot
Sudden life upheaval leaving her to face the track and life alone
Italian origin and director Matteo Rovere
excludedMaterial: Specific plot twists following the rupture
Subsequent family developments or late relationship arcs
